title: Benchmark FAIR scoring output
description: Structured output contract for fair-assessor-* benchmark and census spawns; supplied at spawn per the agent definition's output contract. Receipts are required fields: a scoring record without receipts is a schema failure, not a warning. v1.1 (2026-08-14): ESCALATE no longer forces fabricated scoring blocks (audit C6) — scoring blocks are required only when status is OK, and escalate_reason is required when status is ESCALATE; bounds and minimum lengths added throughout (audit M12); the A1 cross-reference is soft-enforced — coverage_category minimal/partial with A1 scored 1 requires a named a1_exception_rationale, honouring the instrument's ethical-restriction exception rather than hard-zeroing it; schema_version (const) echoes the contract version into every output so the validated contract is self-documented (audit S3); input_provenance carries the ratified research-surface provenance flag as NON-SCORING metadata; sub_principles' optional pack_refs cite evidence-pack record ids (C3/C6 joint design note, instrument-clarification plan). Naming note (audit M13): sub-principle keys replace dots with underscores — instrument A1.1 is schema A1_1, A1.2 is A1_2, R1.1/R1.2/R1.3 are R1_1/R1_2/R1_3.

schema_version.description: Contract self-identification, enforced by the validator: every output names the schema version it validated against (audit S3 — schema identity must be receipted, not hand-typed into run records)

stated_availability.description: Descriptive record of availability statements only; never mapped to L1-L6 (preregistration section 7.3)

input_provenance.description: Ratified research-surface rule (erratum-log Entry 3, item 1): provenance is recorded per required input as NON-SCORING metadata — it never affects any sub-principle score; it keeps responsibility reportable as a study finding

input.description: The required input as named in the paper (dataset, code repository, or other digital input)

a1_exception_rationale.description: Required only when data coverage_category is minimal/partial AND data A1 is scored 1: names the documented ethical/legal restriction (CARE principles, human subjects) that the instrument's A1 cross-reference excepts (preregistration section 7.1)

evidence.description: Quote or concrete observation grounding the score; for absent, what was looked for and not found

pack_refs.description: Optional citations of evidence-pack record ids (C3/C6 joint design: record_id = '<endpoint>:<identifier>', stable within a pack); paper-only scoring omits this
